title: Project Accountant / Project Manager
description:
Accountivity is hiring!

Job Title: Project Accountant / Project Manager
Location: Niagara Region, ON
Job Type: Full-Time, Contract (On-site / Hybrid)
Salary: $45.00-$49.00/hour

Our client is seeking a Project Accountant / Project Manager to oversee both the financial and operational aspects of large-scale manufacturing projects. The successful candidate will manage budgets, costing, and project execution while leading cross-functional teams to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget.

This role is ideal for a professional with strong manufacturing accounting, costing, and project management experience, coupled with at least 2 years in a leadership or managerial role.

 
Key Responsibilities:
Accounting & Costing
  • Develop and manage project budgets, forecasts, and financial reports.
  • Track and analyze material, labour, and overhead costs to ensure accurate project costing.
  • Perform construction accounting, including work-in-progress (WIP), job cost allocations, and progress billing.
  • Prepare and monitor financial performance reports, identify variances, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Manage invoicing, revenue recognition, and ensure compliance with accounting standards and internal controls.
  • Collaborate with procurement, operations, and engineering to align project costs and resource planning.
Project Management
  • Oversee project schedules, deliverables, and milestones from initiation to completion.
  • Lead cross-functional teams in manufacturing and construction project environments.
  • Identify risks, maintain project documentation, and ensure adherence to safety and regulatory standards.
  • Communicate project status, financials, and progress updates to leadership and clients.
  • Foster collaboration between departments to drive efficiency and accountability.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Engineering, or Business Administration.
  • CPA designation (or working toward one) is an asset.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in project or manufacturing accounting, with at least 2 years in a managerial or leadership role.
  • Proven background in cost accounting (materials, labour, overhead).
  • Experience with construction accounting and manufacturing project environments.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Dynamics NAV (Navision) ERP system and Excel (advanced).
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and leadership skills.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
If you meet the above qualifications, please submit your resume. Please note that while we appreciate all applications, only those being considered will be contacted.
